aktivitet: Utvikling og vedlikehold av programvare for gaveløsninger, integrert
med tredjepartsleverandører, og tilbyr analyser for å optimalisere
gavekampanjer for bedrifter og individuelle kunder.
vedtektsfestetFormaal: Wishcast is a platform that allows users to create a profile and
create a wishlist of items they would like to receive as gifts. Other
users can then view the wishlists and purchase items as gifts for the
user. This allows for a more personalized and seamless gift-giving
experience, as the recipient is more likely to receive a gift they
will enjoy. The platform can also be used by individuals to keep track
of their own gift ideas and by event planners to plan for events like
weddings and baby showers. Wishcast is a great way for people to keep
track of their wishes and the wishes of the people around them, making
gift-giving more special, meaningful and fun.
